title: Saturated cardiolipins are potent disruptors of inner mitochondrial membrane structure and function.
authors: Venkatraman, Kailash; Milshteyn, Daniel; Sarto, Carolina; Kocharian, Elida; Sakurai, Cailyn M; Armando, Aaron M; Wong, Adrian M; Dennis, Edward A; Fang, Xi; Lee, Christopher T; Budin, Itay
one_liner_zh: 该文研究饱和心磷脂对线粒体内膜结构与功能的影响，虽含分子动力学分析，但核心是脂质膜体系而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cardiolipin (CL) is a four acyl chain, mitochondrial-specific phospholipid crucial for maintenance of inner mitochondrial membrane (IMM) structure and function. In healthy tissues, CL acyl chains are highly unsaturated and maintained by a conserved remodeling pathway. However, dysregulation of CL acyl chain composition can arise from mutations in the CL transacylase, Tafazzin (TAZ), resulting in Barth syndrome (BTHS), where patients exhibit heightened mitochondrial dysfunction. Cells lacking TAZ accumulate three acyl chain monolysocardiolipin (MLCL) as well as CL species with saturated acyl chains (CL(sat)). While the presence of MLCL destabilizes electron transport chain (ETC) complexes and IMM-shaping proteins, the contributions of CL(sat) to mitochondrial dysfunction have not been elucidated. Here, we find that treatment of TAZ knockout cells with exogenous saturated fatty acids causes accumulation of CL(sat) and loss of IMM structure despite only minimal changes in MLCL composition. Cells with elevated CL(sat) show reduced fluidity of the inner membrane measured by a solvatochromic probe. Biophysical measurements and molecular dynamics analyses showed that di-saturated (C16:0 18:1)(2) CL species order and rigidify membranes, while also losing the intrinsic lipid curvature characteristic of tetra-unsaturated CL. These results implicate CL(sat) as a potential driver of mitochondrial dysfunction and an additional therapeutic target in mitigating BTHS pathology.
abstract_zh: 心磷脂（CL）是一种具有四条酰基链、线粒体特异性的磷脂，对维持线粒体内膜（IMM）的结构和功能至关重要。在健康组织中，CL酰基链高度不饱和，并通过保守的重塑途径维持。然而，CL酰基链组成的失调可能源于CL转酰基酶Tafazzin（TAZ）的突变，导致Barth综合征（BTHS），患者表现出加剧的线粒体功能障碍。缺乏TAZ的细胞积累三条酰基链的单溶血心磷脂（MLCL）以及具有饱和酰基链的CL种类（CL(sat)）。虽然MLCL的存在使电子传递链（ETC）复合物和IMM塑形蛋白不稳定，但CL(sat)对线粒体功能障碍的贡献尚未阐明。在此，我们发现，用外源性饱和脂肪酸处理TAZ敲除细胞会导致CL(sat)积累和IMM结构丧失，尽管MLCL组成仅有微小变化。通过溶剂化显色探针测量，CL(sat)升高的细胞显示内膜流动性降低。生物物理测量和分子动力学分析表明，双饱和（C16:0 18:1）(2) CL种类使膜有序化和硬化，同时失去四不饱和CL特有的内在脂质曲率。这些结果暗示CL(sat)可能是线粒体功能障碍的驱动因素，并作为缓解BTHS病理的额外治疗靶点。
